english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken word for a physical cavity, pit, dent, or opening through something.
Use 窿 as the all-purpose colloquial noun for a physical hole or gap that something can pass through.
Use this for a visible hole or tear in clothing or another material.
Use this for a hole or opening in earth or rock, especially when it is not a large walk-in cavern.
Use 窿 for a small hole or burrow made by an animal, not normally for a constructed tunnel.
